text:
Went to Another Broken Egg for the first time for brunch with my sister and a friend. 
The atmosphere was relaxing but also upbeat. Our waitress, Elise, was so friendly, hospitable, and really took her time to walk us through the menu. 
I had the eggs black stone benedict--it was delicious!
I'm not a coffee drinker, but my sister said their medium roast coffee was amazing. 
We will definitely be back!

Great service, excellent food!
Love the new location. Westport plaza is perfect for you guys thanks again.

We are in day (who's still counting) of CoronaVirus.  My son in law is a great cook but we were so so tired of eating home cooked food.  Read about the Zinburger 4 hamburgers plus sides for $25 and jumped on it.  The reservation and pick up process was efficient and the food was sooooo yummy.  We gave a huge tip because these front line workers deserve it.  We are foodies and passionate supporters of Tucson Restaurants.  Praying this is over soon and they can begin their recovery.

This place is a great option for lunch. Many of the surrounding restaurants are popular, and thus are very busy. If you don't have the time to wait, check this place out. No line, great wraps, and tasty sides.

WOW! first time here. We had spent two days in downtown Philadelphia and were meeting my fiance's relatives at this restaurant, which was 20  minutes from their house. 6 of us. 

Honestly, this restaurant is definitely 5-stars. Incredible service and wish i could remember her name. Knew the menu so well and even took time to get a gluten free roll for one of our guests while we snacked on the other rolls.

Cucumber and salmon mouse sandwich for me and I kept sneaking french fries from my fiance's plate - outstanding. 

The quality of the food and the great choices (rotating menus with the seasons) made me wish i could have eaten here more times!

Truly a treat and such a well decorated restaurant too!

Good food. Three of us ate and everyone was happy. Only been twice, but really looking forward to trying different stuff on their menu. This place has the potential to be a long term, iconic place. I'd definitely recommend giving them a shot.

Really good pizza! Definitely my favorite here in Reno.

The bottom of the pizza has a nice crust to it and just overall tastes really good. My favorite thing is the garlic knots, but they don't have them at the moment as he gets back into the swing of things!


Speaking of which the people who work here are also great and really nice! Highly recommend!!
I loved their strawberry lemonade so much that I gotten twice in one day. The macarons were a great end of the day.

Went to Green Pheasant last week to entertain clients in from Minnesota.  I had been prepped by a couple of my colleagues that the food was "life changing" and, I am pleased to say, that they did not disappoint.  Between the 5 of us, we ordered probably 15 different small plates and **every** one was exceptional.  In particular, the Spicy Crab Noodles, Wagyu Steak, and Gyoza were excellent.  Our server was outstanding and very informative.

Great food, attentive service and a nice atmosphere!  It is the best Greek food I've had in any restaurant.
The spanakopita is the best!  A perfect blend of cheeses and spinach in crispy fillo dough.  
Delicious hummus and the lightest kourabiedes (almond and powder sugar cookies) I've ever had. 
Nice staff and friendly owners, too.  I highly recommend this place.

Pretty good bakery in the Chinatown area with one special feature - hot and fresh baked goods throughout the day!! Instead of being mass cooked in the morning there's fresh baked goods constantly coming in which are always quite the treat. I'm a big fan of the custard bun and almond butter bun, but many are yet to be tried. Since the buns are always coming out throughout the day, the selection at one time isn't always too extensive but everything made here is good.

An added convenience is their acceptance of Venmo for payments, pretty rare for Chinatown. Next time I will have to try their cakes too. :D

Friday night is crowded, obviously, waited 25mins to be seated, but the server was excellent and attentive. Took a bit long making the food, but when it came it was worth it.  Salmon was delicious.  
We enjoyed walking the mall afterward and then playing the games.  They let you use tickets towards food now FYI 750 gets you appetizer or dessert.  That's nice for adults who play.

Stopped in for a bite to eat with my mom and daughter. We'd driven past a few times and wanted to check it out. What a great place! It's much bigger than it looks from the outside. The staff is very friendly and the food is great. We both had the egg sandwich on a croissant and it was delicious. Can't wait to try the other items.

This is a tough one for me as I was hoping the food would live up to the name. The Treasure Valley has a TON of wonderful food, but one thing they're still trying to perfect is the Mexican food. Just like everyone else who seems to have already reviewed this place, I am ORIGINALLY from Southern California as well, and feel like I know good Mexican food. This place is decent Mexican food. Here we go:

After reading about this place a bunch of Facebook, I've wanted to try it since it's grand opening last week. I mean, if the name of your establishment is literally something like "California Mexican Food," you better live up to the hype. That's like going to a place called "Maryland Crab Cakes" or "Chicago Deep Dish Pizza" or "Alabama Fried Butter." If you reference what something is known for, make sure it's the best. Cruised over and saw they had a drive thru, which is lovely as I didn't have a lot of time, so I jumped in line and ordered. Two things I always judge a new Mexican place on are their bean and cheese burrito and their carne asada burrito. I ordered those, as well as a "jumbo" carnitas taco and a crispy beef taco. Relatively inexpensive for the four items...I think it was like 15 or 16? Went home and busted open the bag. Started with the crispy beef taco. Pretty oily, which I don't mind THAT much if the flavor is there. The flavor was kind of there. I enjoyed it, but not enough to warrant the amount of grease spewing out of it. Next up, the carnitas taco. Not to ru

Hesitant to try at first because most diners are about the same and ive already got my favorite but I've come in a few times with my dad and have been seriously impressed, service is great, menu is large and fun to navigate, portions are huge and holy moly THOSE BISCUITS!
My go to place during quarantine when I want to eat something with more flavor. I always get mapo tofu and the lamb dish.
10/10 would recommend. Great service and amazing staff. The food was great everything was perfect. Highly recommend the parmesan truffle fries.
We found this place on yelp and I am glad we did. The food was so good and worth the wait. Definitely my favorite in the area and we will go back every time we are in town.

Michael was horrible. Only seating outside which I understand. However they keep the hostess check in inside. I walked into to get my table and wasn't greeted kindly but instead with "you need to wear a mask!"  I said I need a table for two. He said. "YOU NEED A MASK.   Yes I understand but we were not planning  on being inside at all I just need to get a table for two. Which by the way was literally 30foot from my parking spot. I came back in with a mask and said there I have a mask can I get a table for 2. He said. "Only if you have a good attitude". What?  And you want my money?  I'll eat at another establishment and Michael kiss my tail.
Great spot for a quick smoothie or a bite. The menu has expanded which is great.  Love their mission!

We were looking for something new and local and after Yelping we found this gem! Relaxing decor and open spaces made the tables seem private and not too close to the neighboring tables. While there are not many tables, it's worth waiting if you have to. 
Our waitress was friendly and attentive, and when she was busy others were quick to check on us and bring food or drink refills. We very much enjoyed the Pad Thai chicken wings!!! We got them medium and they were delicious without being too spicy, just right!! (my husband would probably have liked hot, but I'm chicken, lol) I had the Drunken noodles with chicken, (medium) and he had the Garlic and Black Pepper Beef (hot). Both were wonderful! The staff again were terrific even though they got pretty busy. They do a brisk take out business as well so in a pinch we will have to try getting our food as we drive by.
We had a very relaxing and enjoyable evening and will return another time and bring friend and and family.

We wandered in here on the 4th because we were starving. We were seated right away. There was live music playing the whole time we were there, which was a plus. The biggest negative is that it took 45 minutes to get mediocre food. My friend and I ordered mild chicken fingers with Texas toast and our fingers were too hot and their idea of Texas toast was white wonder bread with nothing on it! The fries were cold as well. Drinks were a little pricey as well, but that can be expected downtown.

Really enjoyed my visit to Zoe's! I got the Mediterranean salad bowl with salmon and it was delicious! The ingredients are very fresh and the staff is very helpful and friendly. Definitely worth checking out!
DELICIOUS FOOD!! Food was so good and always had chips and salsa on hand great food! Great service!!! My new favorite Mexican resturant!!
I went here for the first time tonight. The customer  service was phenomenal! The food was good. I will be returning soon.
Great food and great service.  We tried this place after seeing it on the food network.

Pre-May 5th tacos, this spot had been on my Bookmarks for some time. Prime location situated within the neighborhood of Clayton. Perfect walking distance for locals. I was lucky enough to grab a street parking spot right in front of the building. 
This place offers both indoor and outdoor seating, however the overall size of the restaurant is small, so if you visit during the colder months, it might not be easy to get a seat.
Browsing the menu, I settled on the Fried Avocado, Fish Taco and Chicken Tinga Taco. My favorite of everything was the Fish Taco, very crispy and the accompaniments in the taco were a perfect combination. 
The chicken rings was mostly just chicken and while alot of meat is great, it needed something to compliment the texture, like crispy lettuce or fresh pico.
The fried Avocado was definitely outside my comfort zone and IMO needed a little more seasoning, but the dipping sauce does help it a bit.
Overall a solid meal, makes for a good lunch on a random Clayton day.

Great food and service. I visited Italy this summer and after returning it was difficult to find good spaghetti, until this place. Their food took me back to the Amalfi Coast. They are authentic with their flavors. I would recommend this place
Food is good but it's always a hassles. Either you call and no one answers the phone or the order is wrong. Too many other places around to deal with that.

This is one of my favorite restaurants ever! Sister restaurant to the original Frenchy's, this restaurant is much bigger but still turns out the same delicious food. We usually come here when the wait for Frenchy's is too long .No visit for my family and I is complete without their mouth watering fish spread. It's so good that since trying it so many years ago for the first time, every fish spread I've ever had since then as been compared to Frenchy's. They have a full menu complete with chicken dishes and burgers for the non-seafood lovers but the seafood is really where it's at. My personal favorite is their original grouper sandwich, I can't even begin to describe how delicious it is. They also have daily specials on weekdays. Drinks here are really reasonable and made really well.  No trip to Clearwater Beach is complete without a visit to Frenchy's or one of their  other three restaurants on Clearwater Beach. Dont miss it, believe me, you'll thank me!

Ordered through Postmates and I am NOT disappointed!! I have been looking for a place in the city that I love and I think I found it. Now this review is based on only ordering one time but I hope to have as excellent as an experience as I have tonight. I, myself, prefer a sweeter crab Rangoon and these were top notch. Perfect size in general but I was sad that only 4 came in an order, I finished the whole order myself and wanted more  
I also ordered vegetable fried rice without mushrooms and it was phenomenal. 
Finally, I had the fried donuts and omg. Just get them. You won't be mad you did. 
Overall 10/10 for me and will definitely try again!
Great beer and fun atmosphere.  My husband ordered food, fries were great and he said his chicken sandwich on a pita was fair.  Great service.  Would come back again and try something different.

This is my favorite takeout restaurant in Marlton. Their high quality and authentic food makes it somewhat out of the ordinary for the area. Don't miss the crispy duck, wonton soup, and shrimp mousse. Cash only, and they aren't on delivery apps.
Best staff, love the food and the beer Selection is on point.  Come try this place that's all I got to say.  Love the atmosphere has great decor as well....

This place is amazing. The owners are very friendly and nice. Even with the craziness of COVID-19 and plastic screens, their service was superb. Food was 5 stars. Man do they pack that bowl-and salmon was very fresh and opaque. We had the taro milk tea and strawberry milk tea and both were delicious and they don't pack the cups with tons of ice-which annoys me to no end with other boba places. Definitely will be coming back.

The Pho is good, friend rice, Thai fried rice, and the curry dish. Some of the plates are misses, but a lot are very good. Great neighborhood restaurant that you feel good supporting. Four stars for the good dishes, so four stars for Tucson.
Food is absolutely delish!! The pork Bao buns are amazing!!! So unique and flavors are a party in your mouth!! Egg rolls too! Yum

Literally the worst airport meal ever and I fly a lot! Come on Michael... if your names on it it need to be a lot better than this. Veggie burger was the worst ever, and that's no exaggeration, as hard as a brick! If you can't make it right get it off the menu! And the fries, cold! Tasted like they were made an hour ago. This was really a 0 star review. 
BTW, the server was sweet but poorly trained.
Omg! I this place was amazing. My husband and I tried this area because of all the reviews it received in YELP! Thank you to everyone who suggest it!

My wife and I love this place! We've been there multiple times for Carry out and dine-in and have been thoroughly impressed every time. The restaurant is always spotless. The staff is always happy and very friendly. The quality of the food is fantastic. I do not write reviews for restaurants but feel it necessary for Lava Express. I highly recommend.

Kind staff & taste spicy chicken noodles. Chicken & crab pad Thai dishes were okay & duck platter was tasty, even if a little dry. They were out of thai tea when I ordered but I'm sure when they have it, it's tasty too. I didn't see any drinks or desserts on their menu so maybe there's a hidden component to the delights they have to offer. Given their convenient location, I may find myself exploring more of what they have to offer.
This little BBQ place is one of the best around! Support your local, award winning grillers! The food is delicious, homemade everything and daily specials.

Fun beer hall, great for a happy hour or to hang out with friends. Choose one of their beers or a guest beer to enjoy with your food. The prices are decent as the portions are large. I ended up with steak loaded fries special. The shredded prime rib steak on the fries was shredded like a philly cheese style steak and honestly didn't seem like prime rib but more of a hanger steak or some lower quality--which I was not expecting. So the steak had no flavor and the cheese sauce served with it was all kind of bland but sweltering in garlic due to the garlic French fries and it seemed almost like truffle oil was in there too. I was pretty disappointed in the meal thinking it would just be more flavor and better quality. If I go back I probably would just get a sandwich. The regular fries were good, but garlic seemed to be the theme around a lot of their food. But nice chill environment and a great place to be added to the area. I think I will def go back for a happy hour with friends and hang out on their patio !

Do not waste your time unless you can enter establishment. Very poor phone etiquette and lackluster customer service. Very good food, but a refresher course in professionalism and customer service wouldn't hurt.
Winkel may mean "little shop" in Dutch but there is not little about their plates. This was really enough for two people but I didn't share this time. Very friendly staff

I have eaten here once and gotten take out twice. Overall, I think the tacos are generally very good and the other items are okay, but certainly good enough to keep returning. Bests: chicken tacos, guacamole

The queso is like any other queso, but the guacamole I had was very good. My favorite taco is the chicken (really well spiced) and the deluxe option includes canary beans, grilled cheese, and guacamole--which is definitely worth it. I think that some of the taco options might be a touch bland in the non-deluxe versions. The pork has been pretty fatty when I've had it. The farmers taco is a great vegetarian taco. The breakfast taco isn't my favorite, the chorizo seemed to be under-seasoned. 

It's a little hot to sit out in the courtyard for the next couple months, but I'm very happy with this addition to local taco options.

their rush hour happy hour = the best deal. 
awesome food. i recommend the burger, cauliflower, NOLA shrimp, and the pecan brittle sundae.
The best Cuban sandwiches I've ever had.  I stop by every time I'm in the area.  The staff is always super friendly and welcoming.
Super nice coffee shop with friendly staff and good industrial decorations . The oat milk flat white and pumpkin spice cappuccino were both very fantabulous.

Was in Tampa for the day and wanted some dim sum, so I decided to look for places nearby. This place looked good and also had options of dim sum and hot pot. The hot pot was really good but some of the dim sum dishes weren't as good as other places I've tried. Some of the dishes that were good was the shrimp dumplings, custard buns, bbq buns, and soup dumplings. The shrimp ball and shumai were not my favorite, but everything else was delicious.

I've never had a cheesesteak. Like ever. I was turned off by the idea of cheez wiz but when my SO and I were in philly, he decided that although it's well known pats or genos are not the best steaks in town, I had to get one of them first. I got a cheesesteak with wiz and mushrooms. It comes with onions. I also got cheese fries, again a little wary. WTF was I think it was delicious! The fries were my favorite part. The cheesesteak was good and a very large portion, too much for me to fully finish. I see why they are famous, but I also see why other places are probably better. Will be trying a local spot next time we're in town.
The food was good however the quantity of chicken in the chicken kabob was laughable. I ordered via Uber eats and my meal came with 3 small pieces of chicken over an excess of rice
I was visiting someone within walking distance and came here almost every day this week. The baristas are all really nice and the atmosphere is welcoming. Great coffee and lots of great food options

I would say this is the best Chinese buffet in the city.  It has a great selection of soups including wonton and hot and sour, authentic Chinese dishes  like garlic green beans, stir-fried meat and vegetables, bbq pork, seafood of some kind like shrimp, clams and mussels, dim sum, even bbq pork and cocktail buns!  A few kinds of sushi, salad bar and desserts like mango pudding, red bean soup and tapioca .  There's also lots of choices for non-Asians who may not be as adventurous, such as chicken balls, deep fried shrimp, dry ribs, chicken wings, jello and ice cream to name a few.

This restaurant is attached to a Travelodge which looks like it needs an update in decor.  There's parking on both sides of the building and is located along 118 Ave. so it's accessible by transit.  The restaurant is big and can accommodate large parties.  I've bumped into someone I know every time I've eaten here!  I would recommend reservations.

I've been here for lunch and dinner, the price is higher for dinner but we noticed they have crab legs and roast beef in the evening.  We paid $20.99 for lunch and seniors are $2 off.

The taste of everything is good considering it's a buffet.  They do have hot sauce, soy sauce, sweet and sour, etc. available to help yourself.  This place is definitely recommended if you are wanting a variety of Chinese food!

Pizza is good but that girl that worked tonight n most nights she always messes up tHe easiest orders like tonight I irder 2 slices a cake n mint choc chip ice cream gain I get all the way home n it's the wrong ice cream I use to go their every few days just for ice cream n slices n my son also but he said she messes his orders up I've complained many times n the gorl still working their I'm tired of throwing food away bc she can't take a simple order also I make sure to repeat my order to her 2-3xs bc this is a common problem I guess my house hold will have to order else where 3xs a wk now due. To the lack not caring
Everything I ordered tasted amazing. I took pleasure in going out on the limb and trying beef tongue.

So I was excited to try this place for delivery because of all the reviews and the food looking great in pictures..... but when I ordered wings they were just carelessly thrown in a bag with no container? AND they were burned. Idk if it was just a disgruntled staff member that day but I was disappointed... I've never had any restaurant just throw wings in a bag. The cheese steak I had was a generous portion, I got full off of half the sandwich but it was a little dry. I did appreciate the home made potato chips though, they were a really nice touch. I hope my next experience will be better though.

Wow.. absolute perfection . We ordered takeout and it was the most delicious broil I have had. 

The sauce was nice and spicy and all the seafood was so fresh. And The size of crawfish- lets just say you won't be disappointed! I never had a broil with mussels and it was a nice addition. Shrimp,  crab, potato, corn and sausage nicely rounded off the meal. 
There were a number of sides available too- we got the seafood cheese bread and fried okra.

Will be back for sure.

For being the #1 place in Nashville for brunch, the place was just okay. We sat at the bar and Tommy was our bartender. Do not expect to have fast service if he is your bartender. We were the only 2 at the bar from 10am-10:45am and sat with our drinks empty without any acknowledgement from him until we waved him down. Once he made me a drink at the service bar, he continued to talk to his coworkers for another 7-10 minutes and completely forgot he made a drink for me. He turned around to see my empty glass and realized my drink was sitting at the service bar. We ordered the biscuits which they said came with homemade butter; tasted like regular grocery store butter to me ‍. The egg white omelet was smothered in goat cheese. If you're here for a bachelorette party or celebrating something, research somewhere else.

I went there for their kimchi to go. I usually go to the international market downtown Indy, but looked this place up as they boasted fresh kimchi for sale! I've been in the kimchi game long enough to know that this is NOT fresh kimchi. The $27 for a tub of
Kimchi is so not worth it. Kimchi is slightly sour and dry without the pepper sauce. Prob end up throwing this away after the kimchi goes more sour. I'm sure the other food items are good, but In terms of "fresh" kimchi, hard pass
Loved this place forever. Got take away today, it was a great! Poke bowl and gyoza! Everything is always fresh and the service is always wonderful. Try it, you'll love it!!

Been craving for some Korean chicken and I was so glad to find out about this place. I ordered more then I can eat because I wanted to try three different flavors. I got the Thai chili lime, O'
Original and Parmesan garlic. My two favorite was the Thai chili lime, a Southeast Asian inspired  sauce combined with tart lime. The O' Original, red chili and brown sugar caramelized over the wings in a tangy sweet sauce. I didn't care too much for the parmesan garlic too much. It's not bad but you really can't eat more then two and be like it's too rich. The wings are covered with parmesan garlic. Don't forget to add on the Moo. I love those pickle radish. It's more then a wings place. They have chicken tenders, rice bowl, noodle bowl,  sandwiches, wraps, salad Snackers and desserts.

The atmosphere is amazing and quite romantic. Got together with some friends from college here. Had great cocktails and made me a pretty decent martini. Had live music downstairs but we were unfortunately upstairs. Upstairs is very private and cute good for a romantic dinner with a loved one. Food was amazing. Sorry my pictures aren't too good, I don't like using flash in dimly lit restaurants and disturbing others.
They shut down. A shame that good restaurants can't make it and so many chains do so well.   Please post if you reopen.

Epic breakfast. So glad this second OEB opened up, closer to me and in an area with actual street parking available. The lines to be seated are still hectic but it's definitely faster than the downtown branch was. You can usually get seated pretty quickly at the bar if you don't mind the stools. The food is really impeccable. Everything prepared perfectly. They have a liquor license too. I definitely recommend checking the live wait time on yelp before heading there though, it will give you an idea of how busy it is. Just be warned, when it says 0 min wait time that's usually not accurate, there will probably be one or two people waiting for a table, just not enough to create an online queue. The good news is if it's too busy there's lots of great alternatives on 124th so it won't be a wasted trip.

I've only been here once and that was a few years back during my first trip to New Orleans.

I still think about the dish my friend and I shared to this day! That makes me very qualified to write this review! 

This place is so delicious! I believe it was during restaurant week when we went and one of the top restaurants to try in Nola. 

The snapper we had was so flavorful and Rich. The restaurant served it bone in. Pretty interesting and different since most places serve fish fillet.

The area around the restaurant is so pretty cute with a lot of art galleries for you to visit and peruse.

Will def go again!

If you love seafood, and sitting right next to the Truckee River while you eat,then it's Smee's Seafood cuisine you need to get here. 
We started out with drinks. They have a great variety of them. Moved onto our appetizers.  Fresh oysters on a half shell.  So fresh and delicious..
I  ordered fresh clams and dipping bread. I  loved it.  
It rained but we just  didn't care because the food was fabulous. 

A must go to place.
Not the greatest pho in the city and the workers seem a little disconnected from the customers

Great atmosphere, good food and so so service... I want to emphasize that this place could be great! The only criticism was the service... everyone seemed a little less than hostile. The burger was good, fries and milkshake were Great!

Hot pot bone lstock with the freshest seafood, vegetables, meats, and organ meats to choose from.  Ramen and cellophane noodles to add as you prefer with dumplings and fish balls.  Seaweed
Salad, squid  salad, edamame, Kimchi and my numerous flavors to add.  Very enjoyable experience and service was attentive but not obtrusive. 
Try it, you will like it.

Very bland food. The chicken was just okay and the sides really tasted like they were from a retirement home. We ordered the pretzel bites and the cheese tasted like cheap plain cheese and salsa that you can get from any store in a jar. The service was just horrible. There seemed to be a lot of people working there but no one really working. Their big specialty beer there was supposed to come in a "boot" beer mug, we were told they didn't have any clean -even though when we arrived they weren't busy at all. We were the youngest people at the restaurant by about 50 years. I would not recommend this restaurant at all.

This is my go to place for sushi and Thai food in tampa. When you walk in, you feel like you've escaped the busy city and submerged yourself into a different world. The service is always amazing, the food taste excellent. They are also very fast. My husband and I are regulars , we've been going once a week for a year. It's a hole in the wall with spectacular food and that always a great find. I recommend the Monster roll and Thai fried rice. The also have happy hour 5-7 which gives you discounts on sushi and 2-4-1
Drinks .
I have been to this venue upstairs on several occasions although the menu is limited the food is always good I think I the prices are reasonable good meter parking  and well

Had Cafe De Thai via Doordash and it was quite good. Pad Thai is pretty solid for the price and you'll get a decent amount. The Potato Dumplings were delicious. Mango chicken was pretty good as well.

If you enjoy boba, their boba is great; however I did not really like the red bean boba, but that might be personal preference.

Mango Sticky Rice came with a healthy amount of mango, but as with all Thai restaurants, make sure you order this during mango season.

Big open space so you don't feel crowded. They have AYCE for $20 for lunch and $25 for dinner. A la carte prices are good, too. We were just there for a light snack so we ordered three rolls and they came out quickly and attractively. Taste was fresh so we were happy. The weak link for me was the shrimp roll we had (SF Roll) - a little bland -- but would def. go back for the AYCE.

Came here for lunch on a weekday and was surprised by how many people were in the restaurant. We sat indoors but luckily the space is huge and lovely, so they were able to separate tables easily per COVID guidelines. The restaurant has the feel of a proper french bistro; quite the scene and a good place for both a group of friends and a date. It's definitely on the pricier side but you're paying for the ambience. 

To start, we ordered espresso martinis which were strong and delicious. For the food, they brought a stuffed bread basket and were willing to have it toasted for us when we asked for it to be warmed. I then ordered the quiche lorraine and my friend got the french onion soup. The quiche was outstanding, at once light and fluffy and yet decadent with salty bacon bits. My soup was cheesy and filling as well. 

Overall, I really enjoyed my experience. The service was excellent, the food was good, and the ambience was really the star. Would recommend!

I am so grateful to the staff and ownership of Indian Twist! I seriously received the best and was given an experience of a LIFETIME! I actually went to this place back in June 2018 when it first opened to celebrate my father for Father's Day and we definitely got a bang for our buck! 
It was so amazing from the appetizers, to the drinks to the entrées,  and if I were to judge the portion size, it would easily be 11/10 
If you can't eat all the delicious food when you're are dinning in, you will definitely will have enough to take home too!  I also tried the Chicken Biriyani and Garlic Naan 

* I didn't take a photo because my mouth was watering when the food came out haha so I couldn't resist!! 

With that being said, Indian Twist to me is biggest hole in the wall in Tucson! I know for a fact it is in a category for best restaurant in ALL Tucson, Arizona  OVERALL 

Thank you INDIAN TWIST 

Christoph3r Thoma$
#SPICY

Wow! This place has it going on. NOICE! High end everything. Blantons on the shelf - thank you! You get what you pay for - enjoy your earnings here! Manager Kenny running house in there, everyone is always on their game; A+ team all around!
I love this place. It's the hidden gem of the Ybor City. The food is always fresh and tasty!

My takeout order from India Garden is the vegetarian thali, which is guaranteed to leave you uncomfortably full if you try to eat everything in one sitting (I'm not complaining).  So if a samosa, two entrees, rice, naan, raita, and dessert from the comfort of your couch sounds like a Saturday night spent right, I suggest you place your GrubHub order now.

Well my wife and I were hungry for Italian food.   My son And his fiancé recommended Anthony's. 
I have been buying their pizza since there old location burned down. 
    Anthony's rebuilt in Downingtown pa. With an indoor seating area. We ordered the eggplant and fig appetizer and you should too. I used the restroom to wash my hands and it was very clean. 
    I ordered the Fettuccini Bolanaise. My wife ordered pear salad. All I can say is this is my go to restaurant. The meal and service were excellent Ricardo was a great waiter. 

Do not pass this restaurant up! The owner is very approachable and does accommodate you. I would suggest making reservations. The place was full from 6:00 pm through 9:00 pm. We were squeezed in. 
Remarkable and enjoyable. Great atmosphere!

The last few times I've visited this establishment it's been difficult to want to come back.  The last time I was there I ordered crabmeat Rangoon and got fried wonton wrappers?, I went back to ask them to fix this issue.  Got told by the older gentleman (who is hearing impaired) that he heard what I ordered and there was no mistake on their end. Frustrating to communicate that accidents happen sometimes when were all wearing masks, but it was ok if they just redid the order. 
But the main complaint with this establishment lately is.... food is barely luke warm, and steamed rice is old and dried out all the time.

First impressions matter. When I went to be seated my chair had crumbs which I could brush off but stains that I could not. Let's clean up the place!  Deviled eggs good. Tuna taco good. Korean short ribs good. Brussels sprouts good. Meatballs a bit dense but good. The restaurant is a bit loud so conversation can be strained. Food is good but not great.

We accidentally stumbled upon this place and decided to take a look inside. We did the flight tasting of the moonshine and loved it. The flavors were all amazing and there was a great selection. The live music and atmosphere was perfect. Highly recommend this place.

The place used to be good when it first opened. Now the waitstaff look like crack heads and the blacken chicken is not blackened nor was mine cooked. I cut into the breast and it was still raw. Plus could tell it was frozen cheep breast. Plus it took 30 mins to actually have it brought to the table - but thinking that was due to our waiter disappearing a few times. Skip the restaurant and go straight to the bar as the drinks and atmosphere are great to hang out. Highly recommend the courtyard or piano bar, don't ever eat at restaurant.
Cute place. Nice decor and surprisingly good food too! Very comfy place to do work, though can get pretty crowded.

I came here over a year ago and had some kind of grilled cheese with apples. I thought it was a strange combination, but it ended up being delicious. A few days ago, I came here again solely to have dessert. I ordered the "Late Night Delight" and was not disappointed. Easily one of the best desserts I've ever had. The bourbon sauce, candied bananas, and pineapple cake MAKE this dish. If you ever have a late night sweet tooth, this is the perfect dessert. Outstanding!

This buffet is so tasty.  There are 4 long food bars.  One is soup and salads. The next is veggies and potatoes, the third is the meat and cassaroles and a carving station.  Last is the dessert line with sugar free options, ice cream, cake, pies and bread pudding.  Drinks (except water) are and extra cost but lunch is only $8.  The whole place is kept clean and the food is replaced promptly as trays get emptied. The wait staff clears plates and fills water and drinks as needed.
I love there food great atmosphere and great food. Love the drink list also. If you have not tried the parish treat yourself to a little bit of New Orleans. Great place

This is my go-to when in Philadelphia's Rittenhouse area. I almost always get the Taiwanese beef noodle soup. It's as good as what I have had in Taipei. The food here is very authentic and freshly made. I also like the pot stickers very much but the beef noodle soup is a must try. Only outside dining for now but when the open inside it is a nice and comfortable space. The service has always been excellent.

The food, especially the sushi is great. I would suggest dining in because they refuse to hire competent staff to take phone orders, most of them clearly high school students. The last couple times I ordered hibachi noodles they were bland, and they can't seem to make up their minds if the noodles come with vegetables or for an additional fee. I order from them almost weekly and this is always an issue. Other than that, some of the best sushi in town.
Had dinner and drinks with friends there tonight. Super service, delicious food, excellent cocktails and cool piano music.  Can't wait to go back!

Overly priced for this very awesome and fun place!!  
 If you are not there to hang out with friends or have a fun Friday night I would recommend going early as it is cheaper and just as fun. They do have amazing food there and drinks! Their huge Burger is perfect for to share and cheap !

I usually go atleast once here whenever I visit Carmel, IN. I have been visiting this place ever since it opened. 

The food is delicious and I usually go for chicken tikka special with rice and garlic naan. You can't really go wrong with this. The place is clean and the service is nice. Its more of the fast-food style restaurant. You queue up, order at the counter, pay and then take a seat and wait for the food to arrive. 

They also do take outs. Though I wished they used a different container material for food. It's made of a bit cardboard-ish matrial and when you do take out on chicken tikka, the hot curry gets stuck and the paper starts melting off into the food. Other than that, no complains. 

They also carry mango lassi along with generic soda options. The price is reasonable and food is delicious. Definitely recommend trying out this place, if haven't already!

Ordered the Chicken with Garlic Sauce combo plate (not spicy) with fried dumplings. I love that they give you the option to take away some of the spice if you want because while I love Chinese food I'm also a big wimp about spices! 

The combo plate came with fried rice and choice of crab Rangoon or egg roll. I opted for crab Rangoon and they were good, classic rangoons like I'd expect. The combo plate was plenty of food for a super filling meal plus leftovers that I'll be diving into tomorrow! I loved the mix of veggies that came with the garlic chicken. 

The fried dumplings had a good crispy bottom with soft doughy sides. They came with a good dipping sauce as well. Definitely didn't need an additional side with all the food that came with the combo meal but I can't pass up a good dumpling. 

This place is what you'd expect from quick Chinese food place - I'll definitely be back next time I'm craving it!
Love stoping by in the mornings before work and the donuts are freshly made!! They have such a variety I really enjoy their spot!!! Love the place
The service was really bad. The food didnt have any taste. if you love Indian food I recommend don't go here at least for dinner

First time dining at the new location.   The service was, usual terrific!  And the food was awesome. 4 for dinner on a Saturday. first finding on the porch then we asked to eat inside.  The staff was amazingly accommodating.  4 of us had 12 small plates.  Our waitress even recommended a slightly different order to save a little $.   It's a BYOB, so we brought a pre dinner cocktail, whiskey sours, then our own Rioja to add to their Sangria.  Loved the old locations intimacy and quirkiness but the new location is very nice.

I walked to this place which is located next to a bunch of homes. I could smell the deliciousness as I walked up to it a block away. I was able to get a seat by the window and enjoyed people watching while waiting on my meal. There is outdoor seating and people enjoyed being seated outside even in the cold weather. I ordered a seafood white wine pasta which was phenomenal.  The food hit the spot, and made my night. The place is byob, so if you want to enjoy some wine with their great food, make sure you bring a bottle with you. The service was great as well.  I went home satisfied and happy.

I really wanted to love this place as it's one of the very few Venezuelan places in Philly. I was craving some Tequeños and luckily this place wasn't very far from my apartment. I called and placed the order not knowing how much they would be, and was SHOCKED when they told me it was $13 at the counter. 

Okay I thought, must just be getting a bunch of them that's fine by me. Opened it up and there were 5...

Charging $13 for Tequeños IS ABSURD, charging $13 for 5 tequeños (plus tip) is borderline criminal. The other Venezuelan restaurants charge anywhere from $4-6for an order of these, and they are way better too. 

I could maybe see past this if they were actually good, but these didn't even taste like tequenos. It was more like a cheese-y fried wonton. 

Sincerely disappointed. I don't know how they think it's okay to charge double the price of every other restaurant and deliver this sad excuse

Wildflower is an excellent place to dine. Everything from the beautiful atmosphere, unique cocktails, and fresh food make for an amazing experience. Not to mention the staff is lovely and always strives to elevate your experience. Wildflower exceeds all expectations.

Just hand lunch here with my family. The service from Bobbie was perfect, and the food was awesome.
My father had the Lamb Pita and this looked very tasty. Everything was very tasty and we will be coming back

Delivery was easy and fast via Grubhub. We tried the veggie batali sandwich and the batali sandwich and YUM! Both are served on baguettes from Amelia's bakery which were delicious, but you have the option for other breads or a bed of lettuce instead. We want to try their selection of cheese, wine, and all things charcuterie next!
The food was great, but we ordered from Postmates and it seemed bizarre to send hummus without pita...

Sun king is a local staple. The beer is fantastic! The food isn't bar food, it's REAL food and they use quality ingredients. I highly recommend the tacos. The atmosphere is excellent and the patio is the place to be when warm weather rolls around.

This place is huge and very loud. Super loud band on the patio and lots of screaming children. Just not my favorite type of place.  I had a Pain Killer and it was served differently each time and my husband tried several different specialty drinks and nothing was memorable. Both the oysters and seafood chowder were very good. My husband had the paella and he said it was some of the best he ever had. I has shrimp and grits which were fair. Portions are huge. Even though it is huge place, service is quick and efficient but not friendly. It seems they strive to get people in and out as quickly as possible.

Went here with my family thrusday night and honestly I have to say I have mixed reviews. Waited about 5-10 minutes to sit when the restaurant wasn't crowded but whatever, the waitress was decent but my biggest downfall and the reason I took a star off was when leaving I didn't even know this establishment had dessert. The caprese salad was good and I ordered the beef bracoile was also good the sauce was alittle too acidity for my liking. The sangria was good and was needed because we had to wait quite a while for our food and I had to ask twice for my check when I was ready to leave . I'll probably visit this establishment again

HELLO: 
        The Service is good,but the food is too salty too much of it.Since they Open the rest.we complained about too much salt in the food but they haven't done anything about it.The Mgr. Say o yes i will tell the Cooks,nothing happens since they opened the Rest in Tampa.

Fees...
Yes the place is awesome. It looks amazing. It's as good as anything Disney has. A boat ride and an area that looks like New Orleans. But when I was sold a nightly price of $169, then paid $252, I'm trying to figure out how over eighty dollars in fees is possible. Well it's beautiful regardless.

What happened to you Franzone's?!? This place used to be delicious! Absolutely disappointed in our recent dining experience. What once used to be the most delicious broccoli bites that came in abundance, are now mostly breaded nothing and you get six or eight. The French fries had absolutely no salt and we're limp. The crab cake sandwich was just that, a crab cake on an oversized roll. No tarter sauce or cocktail sauce on the side. Total bummer.

Molly Goodhead's Bar is a great place to hang out with friends and enjoy drink, good food, and great conversation. The Girls behind the bar are a lot of fun. We end there often for nightcaps.  Dale and Pam
Love the atmosphere + a take-a-book-leave-a-book wall (awesome)! We ordered cake with edible gold flakes ... best place for coffee and desert.

This is very rarely the case if you look through my reviews, but I actually always devour my food here so quickly that I don't even have a picture of it. Anytime I am running errands and get hungry or need a light lunch because I have a big dinner planned, pizza by the slice at New York Pizza is always where I end up. 

It's conveniently located on Magazine and there's always easy parking nearby. For like $3 you stop in and get a giant slice of very tasty pizza! Usually I just go for the basic cheese bc the flavors are just so good and the cheese is so stringy 

The staff is always so incredibly nice too. There's always a few locals at the bar when I stop in. You might have to wait a couple minutes for a fresh slice, but it's worth it. And if you're in the area late night, Buddha Belly across the street is a really fun bar. You could make a night of it. Pizza and karaoke, what could be better?!

It was a great South Indian food! The service was warm, just the regular South Indian cuisines are better than new things on the menu. My wife tried pizza dosa and wasn't impressed. On the other hand, I have tried rava dosa and thali and those are legit! Reminded me of good south Indian restaurants in India.

Terrible. Never getting my money. Bouncers are extremely disrespectful and think they are entitled. They push everyone around and treat CUSTOMERS like garbage. Definitely going to report this to the better business bureau. If it wasn't for us customers they wouldn't have a job. I spend hundreds of dollars here on Friday nights and this is how I get treated???? Come on do better guys.

Yes! Definitely go here for breakfast! The blueberry biscuit was amazing. My husband got the chicken biscuit and said it was delicious. I got the avocado toast and it was awesome! Wish we had this place in KC.

Great place to stop and eat. All the staff are friendly . I drove 2 hours to enjoy and have a wonderful time Cidney was a great host . Thank you for the great service 
I will go back and have a great time.
Cuban sandwich was great! The wings were above average and the jalepeno poppers were very good except for the marinara sauce that comes with it. It should come with a red pepper jelly sauce.
Eat local!  Excellent pizza. I got the spicy mike, and the touch of honey. MWUAH! Yum. Lovely customer service. Fast!  What else could ya want?

Visited the Pharmacy this past Saturday afternoon with friends. It was quite busy but we were seated fairly quickly, maybe a 10 minute wait. Most people know that burgers are where it's at and we all decided to try a different one. I was especially excited about the beer gravy to dip my fries in. 

Our server seemed pretty distracted and not super focused on us, and while taking our order she said there was a computer issue and abruptly left. She came back a few minutes later and took our order again. When our food came out a couple of orders were wrong...mine did not have the gravy that I ordered. She left so quickly that I wasn't able to tell her and just decided to roll with it, no big deal. 

When we got the check the gravy was still on my bill. I asked her to remove it which turned into another ordeal. She had to find a manager, who was also not able to help for some reason...eventually she said she would just re-ring our order without the gravy. Fine, no big deal...except after paying and looking at my receipt once I got home, it still had the gravy on it. 

It's not the money so much that I am worried about, but just the lack of attention to detail, and then the failure to correct it at multiple opportunities. 

The food was great, no issues there...but step up your service guys.
Awesome place! Really good food and good service. The servers were really nice and accommodating.  The moon Dog Star is delicious!

We have had this place on our list for a while and my husband had taken our son and gone with my in law family. We decided to sneak out during nap time while our teenager watched the kiddo so we could do a late lunch. 

We joined the wait-list and it instructed us exactly when we should show up and check in to ensure our spot - we showed up three minutes prior to our check-in time and we were told an additional 25-35minutes. Ok... a little confused - what is the point of the wait-list...? This was literally the only irritating/off-putting portion of our visit and the ONLY reason its not 5 full stars as this is often a very important aspect of going out to a meal for many people. If we join the wait-list an hour beforehand and are told to show up and check in "By 1:10"... and we show up at 1:07 and you take my phone number and tell me its going to be 25-35 minutes then maybe the online wait-list needs to be 86'd. 

Anywho - while you wait, you can go across the street to AO&Co and get some coffee, taste some wine, get some local treats and snacks (micro grocery style). You can even find local crafter's items there! Twinkle Brews and Bearded Boards guy. 

When we were called over and seated the service was great! Very attentive, answered all of my questions, never made me feel like I was being rushed because the bartenders were busy tending bar and managing multiple customers. The bartender provided lots of tips and advice about wine that I might like and he was indeed correct!
The very best of New Orleans.  Great entertainment and drinks every night.     Enjoy the dialing piano bar at night and the courtyard by day.

Phiilly Cheesesteak sandwich is more like a bread sandwich.  Sloppy preparation, bun cold, too much bread! Hey where's the meat????? This is Philly! If you can't make a good cheesesteak, don't sell it.
The flavors were similar to cafeteria food. We had a burger and a chicken sandwich. They were the same price as better quality offerings in town.

An Irish Bar.... that serves bomb ass Italian food? Located right on the corner of Girard Avenue and Shackamaxom Street? Please do tell me more! 

I'm gonna be honest--I've never actually heard of this place until the other day, but boy have I been missing out! I was scrolling through Yelp looking for a place to grab dinner (honestly quarantine has given us so many take out options that I never would've even considered/have been able to order takeout from before) and my friends were like "have you even been to Murph's? We've never been able to get a reservation, but have been ordering takeout every week, this place is legit." OKAY YOU HAD ME SOLD. 

They've been posting their menu on their Instagram and Facebook (I don't think they have a website, if they do it's not listed on their Instagram) and then you give them a ring, no online platform to order through. Also CASH ONLY. 

I got an both app and an entree: the Fried Smoked Mozzarella Sticks and the Seafood Manicotti 

I started off with the Mozz, and those bad boys were MASSIVE. Literally an entire block of Mozz for just one stick (more like a log). I'm not kidding when I say these may have been the best mozzarella sticks of my life, and ya girl has had her fair share of mozzarella sticks. The smoked cheese really made a difference, and there was no air bubble separating the batter from the cheese (I hate when that happens I feel like I'm being skimped when I know it's technically science). Solid cheese the whole way thro

That place was amazing, I ate the shrimp poboys with french fries and sweet potatoes fries covered by cheese and some meat.  It was yummy, amazing place to be with a good parking for the perfect price.
A world of difference in the Gulch. This place is friendly and bustling. The drinks are great and are served quickly with a smile and friendly greeting. We also enjoyed the flatbread.
The living room is a cozy little spot with great brunch food and coffee. Even during the shut down they continued to provide excellent service. We recently visited and sat outside by their fire pits.

Wonderful spot for a bite of Thsi food, and the view of Broadripple. Just across from the canal. 

Don't be afraid to adda little heat. Mmm

We had two different dishes and they were both good, but i wish we had gone a little more on the heat.

Honestly the food was great, however we were blatantly lied to that they were out of peach nectar for the mimosas. Only problem with that was we were sitting directly across from the drink making station and watched them pour several glasses of peach nectar FOR MIMOSAS! Also bar tender was fingering all the garnishes. Oh and they don't care about covid because they sat someone within 1 seat of me.

Great BBQ right here in Collingswood! Their meat and sides are always delicious, and the food is never cheap or greasy. Also I love that they have a seitan option, which I've loved even though I'm not vegetarian. They seem to have pivoted well to a takeout-only operation during COVID, and we were happy with the quality when we recently ordered lunch from them.

We bought the Groupon for this location and were told we HAD to come in to use it and we could not order the phone. 10 minutes later we arrive at the store and the one we had JUST spoken to on the phone says he can't take our order and we will have to wait 30 minutes while he makes orders. Absolutely ridiculous! We had to meet our friends and we're already late, we were dumbfounded at the fact that we had already paid and done exactly what he told us to do then had the audacity to tell us to wait.... now we're down $25 and have no dinner. I would never go here.

Old rice, watery sauce, no veggies other than stale carrots... what no broccoli or other veggies? Too expensive for old rice and very few vegetables. We had 4 dishes and 3 has sauces that were watery thin. 

For over $100... ridiculous!

Bunch of scam artists. Ordered food multiples times and the delivery said that it was delivered. Complained to the stood and they never did anything about it after i showed them proof of me calling post delivery. They don't care about the customer.

It's not a good start when your wife says "I can't find the burger" when you're eating at a burger place...the patty was much smaller than expected. We got the cheese charburger and it was just ok. I thought the sweet potato fries were great. Also the strawberry limeade was delicious. They just didn't deliver on their main thing - the burger.
Laurie was such a great server! Her recommendations were spot on and the sweetest ever. Definitely will be coming back on my next Tampa trip. Thank you Laurie!

This is place reminds me so much of my honeymoon through Italy. The food here is authentic, delicious and incredibly consistent. My wife and I have been coming here for years and will continue to keep coming back. We just ordered for the first time since the pandemic and everything was just as it is when we dine in. Kudos fellas for the continued excellence!!

This place has amazing margaritas with fresh fruit purée as well as a large beer and wine menu. The food offerings are amazing. I love both the alligator bites and the débris fries.  Neither are stingy on the meat so you get a good portion. Sitting outside with a view of the levee is really fun and I highly recommend the Poncharita.

This is the best restaurant in town! The delicious and healthy food is served in a fun, casual atmosphere. The service is great as well. I especially like the Tuesday all you can eat Brazilian barbecue as it tastes great and is an amazing value. My Brazilian friends ate here to and they said that the food is authentic. Eu gosto muito Brasil Arts Cafe!

I'm really happy that Ike's has moved closer to SB. I had a great sandwich and Ike was there personally opening up the new location. It's nice having a new deli in this area as well. I wish them the best and look forward to coming back often!

Always good food, but dining indoors was a cramped and loud experince.  Wala!  Now they have nice tables set up outside, and problem solved.  My wife and I started going back and have been their 3X this summer.  Very good food, comfy outdoor dining, and safe.  They have begun indoor dining with restrictions, but why take the added risk (and the CDC is telling us the added risk is SUBSTANTIAL).  We will continue to visit until the weather prohibits outdoor dining, then move to several places with heaters.  (Pescatories, The Gables, McKinzie, etc.)

Just one star for website notifications. But still 5 's for food quality and customer service. We never had bad service from any locations. We were very disappointed to have to drive 4 hours from northern cal just to find out they are close for Martin Luther King. The website diid not say they were close nor did the phone voicemail. We still love your chicken and will still travel her to get some until they open one up north, but please update the website or even your phones to say your close for a certain holiday or what not! Thank you

Decided to try out this new Burger place in Warrington. The first time I had delicious food but a pretty long wait. The second time was a completely different - and way better - experience! The food came out quickly and was cooked to perfection. Thanks for the great service.

The food is always good at Los Agaves
Any Santa Barbara trip not complete without a visit to Los Agaves
Molce Jete is awesome

Great experience at Pokeworks last week! I was in the area for meetings and this came as a suggestion for a healthy lunch. I selected the spicy ahi bowl but customized my order with a bunch of add-ons. The employees were so friendly and patient while I made my selections. I also received 10% off my order, I think because I was a first timer. I'd definitely return when in the area.

Made it out to Big Lug during the pandemic, and was excited for all their patio seating! 100% recommend the cauliflower wings - they were AMAZING! And also really liked their beers. I would probably not order the same entree I did this time (Beyond Meatless sub, was just average) and try something else a bit more original on their menu, since they had so many vegetarian options! But definitely will be back. Loved our server and the entire experience!

Excellent food. Attentive wait staff. Ask to be seated at Jamie G's table! She's great. Always a wait but well worth it. If you love bourbon and whiskey you will love their bar. Highly recommend the salmon Caesar salad, smoked chicken, definitely order a side of white Mac and Cheese.

You all need to find a way to change yall menu back !!! The new menu SUCK I almost threw that mess up ...plus I miss the gladiator tacos ! Why would y'all take the tacos off of the menu?! I don't understand. I can't be the only person who feel this way lol

This was the first time going and may come back.  They had the Porterhouse on sale for 19.99 so decided to try it.  The cut was thin but sear was good and taste was ok. Got the sweet potato tots which were good.  The service was decent but I've had faster elsewhere.  

Only gave 3 stars because because dinner was just ok.  There are other steakhouses I prefer for similar cost.
